transcript:
alex.s: Starting a sustained POC run for EmberHealth — goal: 500 qps mixed (chat 60% / embeds 40%) for 2 hours. Need ops to spin the Dedicated pool and confirm KMS settings.
priya.se: Got it. Which model variants are we testing? 2x32-bit quant and 4x8-bit quant?
rui.eng: We'll test rwd-llama-70b (bf16), rwd-llama-13b-8q, and an 8-bit quantized 70b fallback. Routing policy: latency-first for 95th pct.
sam.ops: Spinning up a 4-node Dedicated pool (A100) now. KMS vault access set to EmberHealth service account. ETA ~8m.
alex.s: Thanks. Also need a quick pricing check: prospect asks expected token cost at 500 qps sustained over month (peak windows). Can we ballpark unit cost and committed discount tiers?
priya.se: Ballpark: hosted ~ $0.03/token-gen equiv for 70b bf16; Dedicated reserve per-node breaks down to ~$0.009/token with 40% commit discount — I'll draft numbers.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: dedicated-pool/ember-001 -> 4xA100. JobID: dj-7839
rui.eng: Load generator setup (run on k8s perf cluster):
```
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=500 -duration=2h -workers=8 | vegeta report -type=json > ember_run_500qps.json
``` 
rui.eng: Targets mix: /v1/chat (60%), /v1/embeddings (40%). Prompt lengths: chat avg 120 tokens, embeddings 1k dims.
sam.ops: Pool ready and health checks pass. Observability: console route 'ember-poc' created. Start load when ready.
alex.s: Starting run now.
rui.eng: Run update at 00:15: 500 qps steady, sustained throughput ~499 qps, avg latency (chat) 280ms, p95 chat 760ms, p99 1.2s. Embedding calls avg 180ms p95 420ms.
priya.se: Looks good. Any token drop/retry or OOMs?
rui.eng: No OOMs. We saw KV cache miss spike at t=34m causing tail latency bump to 2.3s for ~2m. Root cause: cache eviction threshold too low for the chat prefix distribution.
sam.ops: Increased cache size and adjusted eviction policy at 00:37. No further spikes.
alex.s: Noted. Can we get a simple CSV of per-minute p95/p99 and token counts for the report?
rui.eng: Uploading artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-poc/ember/6901234567/ (ember_run_500qps.json, per_minute_summary.csv)
deploy-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-poc/ember/6901234567/
priya.se: I'll prepare a short slides summary: key numbers, cost estimate, risk notes (cache tuning + KMS latency variance). Also include recommended Dedicated commit to hit target unit cost.
alex.s: One more ask from prospect: security questionnaire flagged KMS CMK rotation and audit logs retention. Sam, can you confirm retention window and rotation policy for this POC?
sam.ops: Retention: audit logs 90 days by default for POC; can extend under enterprise contract. Key rotation: annually by default; immediate rotation supported via KMS API. I'll attach the policy doc.
olivia.support: FYI — onboarding checklist completed, SOC doc link: https://redwood.co/soc/ember
alex.s: Great. Next steps: priya to send cost slide + short results, rui to attach perf artifacts, sam to attach KMS/audit docs. I'll sync with EmberHealth tomorrow EOD.
priya.se: Will do. Adding conservative SLA note: plan for canary + auto-fallback to 13B quant during region failures.
rui.eng: Final numbers summary (2h run): sustained 499 qps, chat avg latency 280ms, p95 760ms, embeddings avg 180ms; total tokens processed ~86M. No service errors. Artifacts uploaded.
alex.s: Perfect — thanks team :tada:
Participants: alex.s, priya.se, rui.eng, sam.ops, deploy-bot, olivia.support
